text.text: I stayed here overnight last month and forgot a bag of mine along with other belongings. At first, I didn’t even know I had left it there, and I didn’t figure it out until over a week later. Past their 3 day policy for holding forgotten items. Luckily for me, they’re awesome and when I called them, they knew exactly who I was and had been holding my stuff for a little bit longer in case I called them back. I was able to come the next day and grab all my stuff, and I just wanted to thank the staff again for their courtesy! Great customer service!

text.text:
This hotel is absolutely horrible. There is a terrible smell throughout the entire hotel. The elevator is disgusting, and the room smells awful. The toilet was stained as if it hadn’t been properly cleaned, there was hair stuck to the bathtub, and the refrigerator had technical issues.

On top of that, the staff was extremely rude, especially Kenny, who handled our problems with complete ignorance and disrespect.

I will never stay at this hotel again and I would never recommend it to anyone. Even one star is too much for this dump.

text.text:
We only stayed here because our flight was canceled and everything else nearby was booked. Even for $83, this place was disgusting.

The second we walked into the room it smelled like urine. The elevator smelled just as bad. When we checked the bed there were black curly hairs not only on top of the bedding but under the covers. There were also black curly hairs in the shower and bugs crawling around (photos attached).

There are absolutely no excuses for a room to be this unclean.

text.text: Not sure if these rooms are thoroughly cleaned after pet owners stay. Allergies were pretty bad, so I know a dog was in that room recently. The pillows are atrocious, bring your own. There were only 3 pillows for two people. 😞
